ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the freeze of child care funding in Minnesota and potential fraud and mismanagement in state agencies
ideas.angle: Financial analysis and public records review
questions: What is the extent of the funding freeze?
Who is responsible for the freeze?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud and mismanagement in Minnesota state agencies, which could lead to significant reforms and accountability
